name: Bergusia
text: Bergusia was the female consort of the Gaulish hammer-deity Ucuetis. Worshippers rendered homage to this pair at Alesia in eastern France, land of Burgundy. She may have served as a patron of the crafts. An underground chamber excavated next to their shrine seems to have held a crafts guild. That discovery ties her to the artisans who worked beside the temple.

attributes.attribute: female consort of the Gaulish hammer-deity Ucuetis

okr.objective: Describe Bergusia as the female consort of the Gaulish hammer-god Ucuetis venerated at Alesia.
key_results: Bergusia is the female consort of Ucuetis.
The pair were venerated at Alesia in Burgundy, eastern France.
An excavated chamber near their shrine hints at a crafts guild and a patron of crafts.
